coverage.deploymentQualification: No experimental backend is promoted by this report; strict-math WebGPU requires nonstandard developer features.

limits: Warm kernel timings do not include the same costs in every runtime; compare their timingScope.
A native BLAS kernel is not a full Scala EFA implementation.
Earlier prototype pipeline files may lack a per-fit input fingerprint; do not treat that missing provenance as verified.
Full-size acceptance requires completed runs, identical input fingerprints, all numerical outputs, memory, responsiveness and cancellation; kernel dimensions alone do not establish it.
